name: synapse-frontend
description: Build of the Synapse web app: TypeScript in src/ is compiled to js/ (not committed). The @codemirror, @lezer, katex, markdown-it (@types) and force-graph packages are here for their types only: the app uses the bundles in vendor/ (built by tools/), pinned to the same versions. @types/chrome types the browser extension (type-checked JavaScript, see ../browser_extension/tsconfig.json).
